-- Banking Model Expected
DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20220222  --142420963567318.22000

SELECT *  FROM BUSC.TRY_TRADES
WHERE LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) = @BusinessDate
 


-- Banking Model
DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20220222  --56570411000.0000

SELECT SUM(BalanceAmount) BalanceAmount FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance_TEST_20231115
WHERE CONVERT(CHAR(8),[Timestamp],112) = @BusinessDate 
AND BalanceTypeID in ('Fixed Income Product Outstanding','Money Market Product Outstanding','Structured Product PYA Outstanding','Structured Product Asset Swap')
AND SourceSystemCode = 'TRY'


-- Data Warehouse -- 
DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20220222 -- 56525123000.00000

SELECT SUM(OutstandingInvestmentFull) OutstandingInvestmentFull 
FROM [DW].[FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment_TEST_20231115]
WHERE BusinessDateSK = @BusinessDate
GROUP BY BusinessDateSK

-- Data Warehouse Expected
DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20220222  --56525123000.0000

SELECT SUM(BalanceAmount) BalanceAmount 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance_TEST_20231115
WHERE CONVERT(CHAR(8),[Timestamp],112) = @BusinessDate 
AND BalanceTypeID in ('Fixed Income Product Outstanding','Money Market Product Outstanding','Structured Product PYA Outstanding','Structured Product Asset Swap')
AND SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' AND IsoCurrencyCode = 'PHP'
